transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for making time for this calibration session. As you know, Taylor's annual performance review is due, and I'd like to walk through the draft together before I finalize it. The current draft flags some missed deliverables as a concern, but I also understand that several of Taylor's priorities shifted during this review cycle. I want to make sure we account for that context fairly. Let's go around the table — I'd like to hear from the project lead first, then a peer colleague, and then HR — so I have a complete picture before I finalize the rating and written record.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Before I give my broader input, I need to put something on the record. My project records show that exactly six of Taylor's delayed deliverables were delayed because leadership reprioritized the work after Taylor had already started it. I haven't yet added this attribution to the calibration notes, but I'm sharing it now so we can factor it into our discussion.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to contribute something from my peer perspective. I directly observed exactly four occasions when Taylor identified a delivery risk early enough for the team to avoid an escalation. These examples haven't been collected in Taylor's review packet yet, but I think they're relevant to giving a complete picture of Taylor's performance — especially alongside the context Grant just shared about the reprioritizations.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share something from my confidential HR records before we finalize this review. Taylor was working under an approved 80 percent schedule for two months of the review cycle. This means the goals and deliverables for that period must be recalibrated to 80 percent of standard capacity. The schedule arrangement was confidential, which is why it hasn't been shared until now, but it's directly relevant to the missed deliverables concern in the draft review and needs to be factored into our calibration.
transcript.speaker: A4
